highlights.title: ChatGPT plan limits in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models now shows a ChatGPT sign-in's limits as Codex last reported them, one meter per limit.

highlights.title: Claude's 5-hour limit in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models now shows a Claude account's 5-hour limit under its weekly one: how much is used and when it resets.

highlights.title: Every permission choice is a button
highlights.line: A Claude agent's permission question shows every choice as a button; one that changes what it may do from now on needs a second press.

highlights.title: Accounts on your other computers
highlights.line: Opened from your Kosmos+ address, Settings, AI Models also lists your other computers' Claude accounts and the agents on them.

highlights.title: An agent needs no project
highlights.line: Agents do not need a project: one taken off its last project is no longer flagged, and a new team's Project is optional.
